structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
Restructured Higher Education Financial and Administrative Operations Act
Restructured Financial and Administrative Authority; Covered Institutions; Management Agreements

law.catch_line: Covered institutions; duties; tuition, fees, rentals, and other charges
law.text: Each covered institution shall fix, revise, charge, and collect tuition, rates, rentals, fees, and other charges for the services, goods, or facilities furnished by or on behalf of such institution and may adopt policies regarding any such service rendered or the use, occupancy, or operation of any such facility.
